utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — could you please keep me posted on the exact time and drop-off spot too? I want to plan ahead and make sure nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the exact time and drop-off spot as soon as I have them, so you can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, got it—wire, sealant, and tools, plus a few small fixes. I’ll double-check the flyer for the start time too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Leo—just let me know if you need that wrench or screwdriver, and I can bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus. I’ll check what’s needed and let you know if I need the wrench or screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, I can bring the tools by and help sort for an hour this afternoon. Just let me know if anything changes, and I’ll pass along any updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s perfect, Tess—thanks. Just bring the tools by the community center Saturday morning, and I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll bring the tools by the community center Saturday morning and keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now and putting together the list of tools and spare parts. If anything’s missing, I’ll let you know before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate that. If you spot anything we’re short on, just let me know and I’ll try to help fill the gaps by the garage at 9.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do, Uli — I’ll send you the list if I find any gaps before 9.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re still taking fence hardware and porch light bulbs—they’d be really helpful. If you’ve got any other small, fixable items, feel free to bring those by too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I can drop off fence hardware and porch light bulbs later. If I spot anything small and fixable, I’ll bring that by too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo—that’d be a huge help. Just swing by whenever it’s convenient.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard it’s getting some good attention—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m just trying to find out what’s still needed most right now. If there’s one item that would help the repair drive right away, I’d love to know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up, but I can ask around and see what’s most needed. If I hear of one item, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks — I can help with that. What’s been fixed so far, and what still needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The broken fence and porch lights still need attention. If you send me the list, I can help keep things on track.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll send you the list and keep it updated. Thanks for helping keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Faye — I’m still catching up, but I can help with the drill and wrench set if you need me to bring them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane — that would help a lot. When is the repair drive happening, and where should I coordinate the school schedule around?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It’s Sunday at the community center now. I’ll bring the drill and wrench set, and you can coordinate the school schedule around that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and send people your way. If you have the details handy, I’ll share them right off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — the repair drive is at the community center on Maple Street, this Saturday from 10 to 2. I’ll send you the full details now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll get that out to folks right away. Thanks, Opal!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard a few more donations came in, so I’m going to check what’s still needed when I’m back. I can bring the tools and help sort things out, but I can only stay for a short while today.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing? When is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing, and when is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, can you check what’s still missing for the repair drive before we go ahead?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll bring the tools by and help sort for an hour this afternoon. I’ll let you know if I hear any new updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — that helps a lot. If anything changes, please send it my way, and I’ll keep everyone updated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll keep my ears open and pass along anything new I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s going pretty well, actually. Have you got anything you want to donate or help fix?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you have any tools or spare parts you can bring by the community center on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still trying to figure out the logistics, Gus—what tools do we already have, and what’s still missing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I'll have the wrench and screwdriver ready for Saturday morning. If anything else comes up, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus—I'll check the list and see what else we're short on before Saturday. If I spot anything missing, I'll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m on my way out now, so I’ll see what’s still short and report back when I’m done.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira. I’ll finish the supply list and let you know what we still need before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Mara—thanks! I’m just waiting on the exact time and drop-off spot, then I can pass along the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks — I can help with that. What’s been fixed so far, and what still needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still checking, honestly — I haven’t got the full list yet. I’ll let you know what still needs attention as soon as I sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem — just let me know when you have the list, and I’ll pitch in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’m still catching up, but I can help with the repair drive on Sunday at the community center. If you need me to bring anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll keep you posted if anything else comes up. I’ll send the repair and supply list when I have it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for the list and be ready Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — that’s the neighborhood repair drive for the broken fence and porch lights. Saturday morning at the community center works, and I appreciate you bringing whatever tools and small appliances you can find.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana — what’s still needed most right now?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Mostly tape, screwdrivers, and any spare light bulbs—plus if anyone has clamps or a drill, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll drop off any extra tools at the school office later today.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — that works. If you can, let me know what else is still needed for the repair drive and I’ll help coordinate around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll swing by later and let you know if I find anything else we need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, do we still need anything besides flyers, donations, and drop-off help?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Those are the main things I’ve got covered so far, but I can check if anyone still needs hands-on repair help too. I’ll keep spreading the word either way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—can you confirm whether we still need any hands-on repair help, or is that covered now?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard it’s going pretty well—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s coming along, thanks for asking. I’ll be by the garage at 9 if anyone wants to help or bring a few extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh nice, I can pass that along—thanks! I’ll see if anyone’s got extra tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Leo — we’re gathering any broken small appliances and tools this weekend, then I’ll sort them for the repair drive. If you can bring anything useful by the community center Saturday morning, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I can bring a couple of tools by Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Leo — thanks! I’ll sort everything out at the community center for the repair drive.
